display_long_description:
Savage Fitness ⚡💀 is a mixed reality fitness game that fuses high-intensity workouts with the thrill of demon-slaying combat. Step into Purgatory 🔥 and purge the lost souls of the damned using your strength, speed, and endurance. Every punch, every lift, every strike becomes a weapon against the hordes of hell.

In Reflex Ball Mode 🥊, test your reaction speed by striking incoming balls with perfect timing. Each punch unleashes a surge of electric energy ⚡, executing enemies in spectacular fashion. In Dumbbell Mode 🏋️, your weights become holy weapons. Perform real-world exercises like curls, squats, and lifts, each rep obliterating demons 💥. In Punching Bag Mode 👹, project enemies onto your home punching bag—no extra trackers required. Every strike connects seamlessly as your foe reacts in real time.

Daily Challenges 📅 bring a new workout, enemy, track 🎵, and world 🌍 to purge. Submit your best run to the Leaderboards 🏆 and climb the charts as you prove yourself among the Executioners.

Savage Fitness also tracks your total daily weight load 📊. Ever wonder how many tons you lift in a single day? Now you’ll know—and watch that number grow as you push past limits 💪.

This is more than fitness. It’s a battle for your body and soul. Will you conquer the Savage Realm ⚔️ and rise as its ultimate Executioner?
